mapper.select: SELECT card_id,revision,review_required,last_review_decision_id,last_history_sequence,updated_at FROM memory_review_gate WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_revalidation_impact upstream JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=upstream.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=upstream.target_item_id AND adopted.id=upstream.target_version_id WHERE upstream.owner_id=s.owner_id AND upstream.target_item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND adopted.version_number <= v.version_number AND upstream.revision=0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM preparation_knowledge_impact upstream JOIN knowledge_version adopted ON adopted.owner_id=upstream.owner_id AND adopted.item_id=upstream.target_item_id AND adopted.id=upstream.target_version_id WHERE upstream.owner_id=s.owner_id AND upstream.target_item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND adopted.version_number <= v.version_number AND upstream.revision=0))
mapper.select: SELECT s.knowledge_item_id AS item_id,s.knowledge_version_id AS version_id,k.kind,v.version_number, k.status,k.current_version_id, CASE WHEN v.id IS NULL OR p.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(v.body AS BINARY) <> CAST(p.body AS BINARY) END AS body_changed, AS upstream_review_required FROM memory_card_source s LEFT JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND v.id=s.knowledge_version_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version p ON p.owner_id=k.owner_id AND p.item_id=k.id AND p.id=k.current_version_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.card_id=#{id} AND s.version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY s.position_index

SELECT i.target_item_id AS item_id,i.target_version_id AS adopted_version_id,v.version_number AS adopted_version_number,i.created_at FROM knowledge_revalidation_impact i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_item_id AND v.id=i.target_version_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{impactId} AND i.revision=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM preparation_knowledge_impact other WHERE other.owner_id=i.owner_id AND other.id=i.id) UNION ALL SELECT i.target_item_id AS item_id,i.target_version_id AS adopted_version_id,v.version_number AS adopted_version_number,i.created_at FROM preparation_knowledge_impact i JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.target_item_id AND v.id=i.target_version_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{impactId} AND i.revision=0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_revalidation_impact other WHERE other.owner_id=i.owner_id AND other.id=i.id)
SELECT prompt_json,reference_text FROM memory_card_version WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{id} AND id=#{versionId}
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory_source_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{id} AND impact_reason='SOURCE_BODY_CHANGED' AND gate_revision > #{afterRevision})

SELECT s.knowledge_item_id AS item_id,s.knowledge_version_id AS version_id,s.position_index AS ordinal, k.kind,v.version_number,c.source_count FROM memory_card_version c LEFT JOIN memory_card_source s ON s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.card_id=c.card_id AND s.version_id=c.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_item k ON k.owner_id=s.owner_id AND k.id=s.knowledge_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=s.owner_id AND v.item_id=s.knowledge_item_id AND v.id=s.knowledge_version_id WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.card_id=#{cardId} AND c.id=#{versionId} ORDER BY s.position_index
SELECT gate_revision FROM memory_source_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{id} AND id=#{decisionId} AND history_kind='SOURCE_REVIEW'
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_schedule SET revision=#{value.revision},cycle_id=#{value.cycleId},status=#{value.status},pause_reason=#{value.pauseReason}, algorithm_version=#{value.algorithmVersion},parameter_version=#{value.parameterVersion},phase=#{value.state.phase},step=#{value.state.step}, stability=#{value.state.stability},difficulty=#{value.state.difficulty},suggested_due_at=#{value.suggestedDueAt},last_review_at=#{value.state.lastReviewAt}, defer_until=#{value.deferUntil},last_rated_event_id=#{value.lastRatedEventId},last_history_sequence=#{value.lastHistorySequence},updated_at=#{value.updatedAt} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND card_id=#{value.cardId} AND revision=#{expected} AND revision < 9007199254740991
mapper.select: SELECT TRUE AS configured,revision,zone_id,daily_new_budget,daily_review_budget,created_at,updated_at FROM memory_review_settings WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
